experiment: Exploratory codec comparison on 40 original photos and 100 teacher-sss frames from each of three video groups
aggregate: Median of each per-image statistic within a group; published at the precision recomputed from the original per-image numeric records

residual.description: Ideal residual d = Y - K*Y, with nearest/replicated borders; double-precision arithmetic rather than the detector's published bfloat16-rounded fingerprint

metric_definitions.image_border_handling: Discard incomplete 16-pixel cells at the bottom/right before computing statistics
metric_definitions.flat_cells: Cells whose mean absolute residual is at or below the 30th percentile
metric_definitions.strong_cells: Cells whose mean absolute residual is at or above the 90th percentile
metric_definitions.flat_e3: 1000 times mean absolute residual over pixels in flat cells
metric_definitions.edge_e3: 1000 times mean absolute residual over pixels in strong cells
metric_definitions.flat_edge: Per-image flat_e3 / max(edge_e3, 1e-9), then median of those ratios; not the ratio of the group medians
metric_definitions.zero: Share of all cropped-image pixels with absolute residual below 2e-4; not restricted to flat cells
metric_definitions.block8: Sum of mean absolute horizontal/vertical residual steps at 8-pixel grid boundaries divided by the corresponding sum elsewhere
metric_definitions.hcorr: Horizontal lag-one Pearson correlation of the signed residual, selecting pairs whose left pixel lies in a flat cell; zero if either selected vector has zero standard deviation

encoding_settings.photo_png: Decoded original-photo pixels, with no injected camera blur in this comparison
encoding_settings.h264: x264 High profile, medium preset, yuv420p, BT.709 limited range, one encoded frame decoded to RGB

limitations: The distance is a chosen exploratory criterion with fixed weights, not a calibrated perceptual or statistical distance.
Frames from the same video are correlated. No confidence intervals or population-level noise-floor equivalence are established.
The data permit rechecking arithmetic on the recorded medians, not independent image extraction, encoding or per-image measurement.
This comparison used original photos without injected blur and does not quantify the separate visual hatching observation.
The choice is conditional on these 40 photos, three video groups, tested settings, metrics and weights.
